data.professional_title: Senior Java Architect | Technical Lead | Microservices Specialist
data.summary: 13+ years of experience in Java/J2EE, Microservices, Cloud (GCP), and API Management (Apigee) with a strong track record of architecting scalable solutions, leading teams, and driving digital transformation. Skilled at modernizing legacy applications and enabling cloud-native architectures while mentoring teams and aligning technology with business goals.

raw_sections.summary:
Professional Summary
13+ years of experience in Java/J2EE, Microservices, Cloud (GCP), and API Management (Apigee) with a strong track record of architecting scalable solutions, leading teams, and driving digital transformation. Proven expertise in system design, microservices adoption, API security, and performance optimization. Skilled at modernizing legacy applications and enabling cloud-native architectures while mentoring teams and aligning technology with business goals.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies
Architecture&Design: Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, System Scalability
Languages&Frameworks: Java 8/17, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MyBatis, Struts, RESTful Web Services
Cloud&API Management: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Apigee, Kubernetes, Docker, Pub/Sub
Databases: Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL
DevOps&Tools: Maven, Git, Jenkins, Gradle, Liquibase, SonarQube
Leadership: Technical Strategy, Team Mentoring, Agile Delivery, Stakeholder Management
Other: Multithreading, JVM Tuning, Performance Optimization, Master Data Management
Technical Skills
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Technical Lead | RxLogix | Aug 2021 – Present
Led a team of 6–7 developers, architecting and developing a pharmacovigilance signal detection system using Spring Boot, Microservices, RabbitMQ, and Spring Cloud.
Designed scalable alert execution for bulk products, integrating multiple data sources and optimizing backend performance by 30%.
Deployed and maintained distributed microservices architecture ensuring high availability and regulatory compliance.
Implemented real-time risk management features improving patient safety monitoring capabilities.
Technology Specialist | NIIT Technologies Limited | Dec 2017 – Aug 2021
Designed and developed DHL’s Neptune platform to support e-commerce logistics using Spring Cloud, Eureka, Zuul, and microservices architecture.
Architected gateway, discovery, and configuration services for modular deployment across multiple regions.
Led API development in Apigee, implementing OAuth 2.0, quota policies, and advanced fault handling.
Migrated distance calculation service from AWS/Node.js to GCP Serverless, leveraging Cloud Functions, Firestore, and Pub/Sub, improving cost efficiency by 25%.
System Analyst | Birlasoft Ltd. | Jun 2012 – Dec 2017
Spearheaded Master Data Management (MDM 2.0) for GE Treasury, designing configurable workflow engines and webflows, enhancing data quality and distribution.
Architected 11 microservices for reference master data (Country, Currency, Legal Entity), enabling search and CRUD operations, improving response times by 40%.
Led multiple teams delivering FATCA, Market Data Services, and Onedata migration projects on Oracle&Spring Boot.
Senior Software Developer | Sify Software Ltd. | Jan 2011 – Jun 2012
Developed Case Information System for the Supreme Court of India (eCourt), digitizing manual processes, enabling real-time case tracking and reducing processing time by 50%.
Software Engineer | IGNOU (eGyanKosh) | Dec 2007 – Jan 2011
Designed and developed ePortFolio and eGyanKosh CMS, providing digital content management for academic resources, improving content accessibility for 50K+ students.
